units.source_text: 这故人永远保存在我心中，教我难于忘却。

en.t: That departed one remains forever in my heart, making it hard for me to forget.

units.source_text: 我多年来孤苦度日，一无欢慰。

en.t: For many years I have lived in loneliness and sorrow, with no comfort at all.

units.source_text: 如今你如此肖似故人，我每次看见了，总疑心是在梦中，更教我恋恋不舍，难于自制了。

en.t: Now that you resemble that person so closely, every time I see you I suspect I am dreaming, and it makes me all the more unable to part from you or control myself.
I only hope that you too will not keep your distance from me!"
As he said this, he took Tamakazura's hand.

units.source_text: 玉鬘因为源氏向来不曾有过此种举动，心中甚是困窘，

en.t: Because Genji had never behaved this way before, Tamakazura felt deeply embarrassed,

units.source_text: 然而也只得乖乖地坐着，答诗云：

en.t: yet she could only sit there obediently and replied with this poem:
